sloka: न हि मे जीवितेनार्थः सीतया चापि लक्ष्मण ।को हि मे विजयेनार्थस्त्वयि पञ्चत्वमागते ।। ६.१०२.४० ।।
transliteration: na hi me jīvitenārthaḥ sītayā cāpi lakṣmaṇa ।ko hi me vijayenārthastvayi pañcatvamāgate ।। 6.102.40 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Sushena the foremost of the Vanaras, a brilliant one crushed the herbs and dropped the extract into Lakshmana's nose.
